messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xx for service 'inference-api' from eu-west2 egress region. 5m error rate 12% (baseline 0.3%). tag=egress-health-check

sasha: I'm oncall. seeing lots of 502/504 from eu-west2 AZ-3, but k8s node health looks fine. starting triage.

raj: looking at routing logs — health-checker service reported AZ-3 unhealthy starting 2023-11-18T09:12:xxZ, but our route policy still had pins to AZ-3 until 09:15Z. mismatch there.

heather: any recent config rollouts to health-checker?

raj: yes, ~09:10Z we rolled health-checker v2 (probe path change + stricter thresholds). rollout flagged as successful by deploy-bot but looks like it returned flaky results for AZ-3.

mike: customers reporting errors: ticket stream shows 34 unique orgs with timeouts; some are high-traffic customers. CS is triaging.

sasha: quick mitigation plan: 1) pause health-checker rollout 2) force route override away from AZ-3 3) open support comms. doing 1 now.

deploy-bot: deploy paused: health-checker/v2 rollout (id: dc-2023-11-18-0910).

raj: command to force route override:
```
# set routing policy to exclude az-3 for eu-west2 temporarily
redwood routes update --region eu-west2 --exclude-az eu-west2-az3 --reason "egress-health-checker mismatch"
```

sasha: running the route update now...

sasha: done. route policy updated. current steady-state now routing away from eu-west2-az3. monitor for 2m.

raj: sanity check logs show 5xx dropping from 12% -> 1.6% within 45s. good signal.

mike: CS update: pushing "we're aware and routing changed to mitigate; intermittent failures should subside within minutes" to top 20 affected customers.

heather: follow-up: why did health-checker mark AZ-3 unhealthy even though nodes were fine? suspicion: probe path change to /healthz returns 200 but slower, and threshold was lowered to 2s which caused timeouts for the node's sidecar under load. combined with asymmetric probe TTL caused route policy to overreact.

raj: pulled raw probe traces: node-sidecar returned 200 but with 1.8s latency spikes at 09:11:30 -> 09:13:00. our new threshold 1.5s triggered flaps.

sasha: next steps: revert thresholds in health-checker config to v1 values; add buffer to avoid transient failures; create a short-term sticky routing window so pinning doesn't immediately re-add excluded az for 10m.

raj: rolling health-checker config rollback now.

deploy-bot: config-change applied: health-checker thresholds -> v1 defaults.

raj: also adding a temporary lock: route-pin cool-down 10m to prevent immediate re-pin. command:
```
redwood config set routing.pin_cooldown 600
```

sasha: monitoring: 5xx now 0.4% and falling. latency back to normal.

mike: CS: sent follow-up notes to affected customers with ETA; no escalations yet.

heather: operational notes: need a postmortem item: health-checker rollout gating (canary size too small), adjust probe thresholds in rollout docs, and ensure route policy honor window when health-checker changes rapidly.

sasha: agreed — I'll open an incident postmortem and assign owners. Creating ticket now.

sasha: incident p0 -> downgraded to p2 (impact contained, mitigation applied). Will keep thread open for doc and RCA. :white_check_mark:
